channel.title: FMCG & consumer · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on FMCG & consumer in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.4).

item.title: [−1] Global freight rates up 130% since February as West Asia tensions lift India's shipping costs
item.description:
Shipping costs keep rising with Hormuz attacks; tanker and container rates are at records. Escalating.

FMCG & consumer: mild headwind (−1) — Imported input costs

Why it matters: Higher freight raises landed costs for imports and erodes exporters' margins, adding to inflation and the trade deficit.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Ukraine can export only 38% of its usual grain; it presses India for a flag-based Black Sea corridor
item.description:
Ukraine asked Turkey, Egypt and India to back a corridor for ships flying their flags. India again urged both sides to protect shipping. Ongoing.

FMCG & consumer: mild headwind (−1) — Edible oil costs

Why it matters: Lower Black Sea grain and sunflower oil exports keep world food prices high; a corridor would ease India's edible oil and fertiliser costs.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
